title: Home at Any Cost
text: Leave the ship in an Escape Pod before the end of round 7 on the Time Track.

title: Last Signal
text: Send a signal. At the end of the game, the Comms Room is malfunctioning.

title: Backup Plan
text: At the end of the game, have at least two crafted items in your possession.

title: No Unnecessary Noise
text: At the end of the game, have no Serious Wounds.

title: Altruist
text: All characters survived (before the final Contamination check). Your own character does not have to survive!

title: Full Power
text: The ship remained intact. All engines are working.

title: Important Sample
text: Send a signal. At the end of the game, a character has a Slime marker.

title: They Are Just Mindless Beasts
text: Two Carnomorph Adaptations have been removed.

title: Hunt for Glory
text: The Butcher is dead.

title: Backup Confirmation
text: You and at least one other character sent a signal.

title: Burned Nest
text: The Nest is destroyed.

title: Weakness at the Source
text: The Carnomorph Adaptation in the Carnomorph Egg slot has been removed.

title: Hypochondriac
text: At the end of the game, you have at least 4 medical items.

title: Mine!
text: At the end of the game, you have at least 1 personal item belonging to another character (their starting weapon or quest item). Leave the ship in an Escape Pod.

title: Hoarder
text: At the end of the game, you have at least seven items.

title: Fallback Option
text: The character ended the game in an Escape Pod with the Antidote.

title: Holy Fire
text: The game ended because a new Fire marker could not be added, or at the end of the game there are at least 4 Fire markers on the ship.

title: I Am Flying Home
text: The ship reached Earth. The character ended the game in the Hibernatorium.

title: In Search of Truth
text: Send a signal. All Rooms on the ship have been explored.

title: Proper Burial
text: Send a signal. The character ended the game in an Escape Pod or in the Hibernatorium with a Character Corpse.

title: Best Friend
text: You and at least one other character survived.

title: The Great Hunt
text: Send a signal. The ship was destroyed or the Butcher is dead.

title: Stop It Here
text: Send a signal. The Nest or the ship is destroyed.

title: Hypercontrol
text: Send a signal. You have obtained all character quest items and your starting weapon is in your hands.

title: AI: Source of Evil
text: At the end of the game, malfunction markers are in at least three Rooms with Terminals.

title: Clean Hands
text: End the game with no items in your possession.

title: Insurance Case
text: End the game with 2 or more Serious Wounds.

title: Teamwork
text: At the end of the game, at least 2 surviving characters have completed their objectives.

title: Claustrophobia
text: At the end of the game, at least 8 doors on the ship are destroyed.

title: Ahead of Schedule
text: Leave the ship in an Escape Pod or enter the Hibernatorium before everyone else.

title: Faith
text:
You may choose this objective only if you have not used a weapon to attack during the game.

Until the end of the game, you cannot perform the Shoot action, throw grenades or Molotov cocktails, or use cards or items that deal damage to Carnomorphs or characters. You may use a Smoke Grenade.

You may hold a weapon and use character-specific cards that refer to a weapon if they do not deal damage.

Objective: send a signal and survive.

title: Living Asset
text: The character of player 1 must survive. Alternative: all players survived.

title: Valuable Witness
text: The character of player 2 must survive. Alternative: all players survived.

title: Evacuation Priority
text: The character of player 4 must survive. Alternative: all players survived.

title: Irreplaceable Staff
text: The character of player 5 must survive. Alternative: all players survived.

title: Last Guarantor
text: The character of player 6 must survive. Alternative: all players survived.
